title: Sync the pantry across the cook's devices

intent.outcome: The cook's recipes are the same on every device
intent.problem: the pantry lived on one laptop

acceptance_criteria.description: a change on one device reaches the other
acceptance_criteria.verification: grep -c '"device"' data/accounts.json && echo "the accounts know their devices"

evidence.command: grep -c '"device"' data/accounts.json && echo "the accounts know their devices"

steps.done_when: both devices hold the same pantry

rounds.notes: The protocol is written down; the client does not follow it.
A device that signed out still writes.
The conflict dialogue takes the whole screen.

findings.description:
## D1 [high] The sync sends the whole pantry on every change

**where:** `pantry-core/src/sync.rs`

**defect:** the protocol says diffs and the client sends the whole file.

**scenario:** change one recipe on a full pantry.

**fix:** send the changed records.
findings.resolution: the client sends only the records that changed

findings.description:
## D1 [high] Two devices editing the same recipe lose one edit

**where:** `pantry-core/src/sync.rs`

**defect:** the later write wins with no record.

**scenario:** edit the same recipe on both devices offline.

**fix:** keep a version and surface the conflict.
findings.resolution: each recipe carries a version; the conflict is shown beside it

findings.description:
## D1 [high] A stale device token still syncs

**where:** `pantry-core/src/sync.rs`

**defect:** the token is checked at sign-in only.

**scenario:** sign out on one device, sync from another old one.

**fix:** check the token on every sync.
findings.resolution: the device token is checked on every sync

findings.description:
## D1 [high] The sync retries forever on a dropped connection

**where:** `pantry-core/src/sync.rs`

**defect:** the retry loop has no backoff and no cap.

**scenario:** sync through a tunnel that drops.

**fix:** back off and stop after five tries.
findings.resolution: the retry backs off and stops after five tries

findings.description:
## D1 [high] The conflict dialogue blocks the pantry screen

**where:** `pantry-web/src/sync.rs`

**defect:** the dialogue is modal over the whole app.

**scenario:** a conflict while planning a week.

**fix:** put the choice beside the recipe.
